content.text: Here are two things for this weekend. Central Library story time is at the Bloor/Gladstone branch on Sat, Aug 8. It's a free indoor drop-in and all ages are welcome. [link-c9bfa2] Riverdale Farm is free and outdoors, and it's open daily. The listing has it for Sun, Aug 9. [link-b8b9f6] Saturday looks dry and warm, so either day should work.
